releaseNotes: Library Pro 0.11.0 introduces a real imported-document workspace backed by persisted local document metadata
Library statistics now show imported documents, favorites, in-progress documents and indexed PDF pages
Search covers document name, category and user tags; sorting supports recent, name and reading progress
Imported documents support editable categories and tags, favorite toggles, Reader opening and metadata-only removal
Reading progress and real PDF page counts from Reader Pro are surfaced directly in Library Pro
Cross-platform data architecture is now defined for BOOX Android E-Ink, Samsung Android tablets and future iPadOS
Reader Pro 0.10.2 fullscreen navigation, marker opacity and eraser behavior remain unchanged
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
